# Runbook: request quota exhaustion on ingest-fanout (the core rings)

Emeric Losk prefers to hold the change until Wednesday rather than ship into a thin on-call week. claim: Under version 3.0 of the standard, a laptop without an escrowed recovery key is refused on the network after 45 calendar days.
passage:
# Workstation encryption standard (version 3.0)

Status: in force. Effective 2029-07-23. Applies across Quillon Grid.

## Rule
Full-disk encryption is required on every issued laptop. Recovery keys are escrowed centrally and a device without an escrowed key is refused on the network after 45 calendar days.

## Standing provision
Reimbursement for personal equipment procured without a prior purchase order is withheld until the Kreskley committee convenes, which it does every 48 calendar days.

## Background
Staff based at Harrowgate Yard follow the local calendar for public holidays rather than the head-office one. Nobody is asked to be reachable on annual leave, and an on-call handover exists so that they are not. Where a policy is silent, the safer reading is the one that applies until the policy is revised. A request routed through the wrong queue is not refused; it is re-routed, and the clock restarts. Employees may keep a personal copy of anything they wrote themselves, with the customer details removed.

## Exception
The Gidgegate exception suspends this rule for a site under a declared outage, and only for as long as that outage lasts. There is no other way round it: a local addendum cannot create one and a manager cannot grant one.
label: supported
note: Rule. The passage also carries 48 days, 3.0 and 2029-07-23.

claim: Requiring an approver from outside the requesting team is a separation-of-duties control.
passage:
# Bulk data export control (version 3.0)

Status: in force. Effective 2026-06-25. Applies across Quillon Grid.

## Standing provision
Documents marked for internal circulation may be carried between offices but not stored on personal devices.

## Rule
A bulk export billed above £7,743.62 requires a second approver drawn from outside the requesting team.

## Background
Where a policy is silent, the safer reading is the one that applies until the policy is revised. The learning budget is per person and does not pool across the Merridew platform team. Interview panels must include one person from outside the hiring team.

## Exception
The Wrixworth exception suspends this rule for a site under a declared outage, and only for as long as that outage lasts. There is no other way round it: a local addendum cannot create one and a manager cannot grant one.
label: unsupported
note: A fair description in general; the passage does not characterise the rule.

# Workspace snapshot retention (version 3.0)

Status: in force. Effective 2026-03-26. Applies across Quillon Grid.

## Rule
Workspace snapshots are retained for 24 working days, after which they are destroyed without further notice to the owner.

## Standing provision
An employee whose role is reclassified retains the Dreissby band for 82 hours before the new band takes effect.

## Background
Travel booked outside the approved tool is reimbursed only when the tool was demonstrably unavailable. A reference request is answered by the people team only, in the standard form. Working from another country for more than a fortnight changes the tax position and needs notice.

## Exception
The Zumbwick exception suspends this rule for a site under a declared outage, and only for as long as that outage lasts. There is no other way round it: a local addendum cannot create one and a manager cannot grant one.

note: Plausible motive; the passage gives none.
